target_customer: Clinical operations and data teams at biotech and pharma sponsors
problem: Clinical trial data sits in separate EDC, lab, vendor and spreadsheet systems, so teams compile trackers by hand and spot risks late.
product_category: Clinical trial data consolidation and operations software

founders.name: Jin Kim
founders.background_notes: YC page: former US Archery Team member and MIT alum.

technical_complexity.rationale: Many vendor integrations and data reconciliation across clinical systems with validation needs.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations into sponsor study data create stickiness, though incumbents hold the underlying systems.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found in sources; Veeva is listed as an integration partner on the company site.

market_need_then: YC page claims over 80 percent of trials are delayed by recruitment and ops teams spend about 15 percent of time compiling reports; company claims, unverified.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, outcome focused: go live in days, not weeks

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word shared with unrelated brands, little press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Miracle is active and says it works with several Nasdaq listed biotechs. An AWS case study in 2025 reports growth from one trial to over a dozen studies, so traction appears real. Funding is not publicly verified, so investor validation cannot be judged.
notes: Bouncewatch lists a 500K pre-seed on 2023-04-05 from YC and North South Ventures (single aggregator, unverified, not recorded). Dated competitor search returned no sources near 2023, so list is empty.
